about: This page is React (src/pages/flows/FlowsPage.jsx, generated by tools/make-react-page.js; engine.js is the graph chunk moved verbatim by tools/extract-engine.js). tools/split-map.js drops the code below and, with it, the chunk's two document listeners for canvas dragging (every function they call is replaced): canvas-pointer.js binds the same handlers while the page is mounted. FLOW, the canvas state, stays in core: the router and the Production graph read it, and the graph's flowBackToGraph is the Production graph page's.
